test_title: SSC Selection Post Graduation Level Official Paper (Held on: 14 March 2022 Shift 3)
subject: general
question: Select the most appropriate option to fill in blank no. 1.
solution: The correct answer is '**upset**'. [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** __ • The most appropriate word for the given blank is '**upset**'. • It means **'the state of being unhappy, disappointed or worried'.** [दुखी, निराश या चिंतित होने की अवस्था या भाव] • *Example: I was** quite upset** with him for being late.* • The word '**upset**' is used when someone is unhappy or disappointed because something bad has happened. • The man was unhappy because the school principal, supervisor and teachers were unaware of their professional responsibilities. **Correct Paragraph:__*** "During my first year of teaching, I was quite (1) **__upset__ **to find that the school principal, supervisor and teachers (2) ________ to be unaware of their professional responsibilities and (3) ________ in executing their duties. For example, my principal's main (4) ________ were that all window shades be at the same (5) ________ , the classrooms be quiet and the rose beds should not be stepped upon."* [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__** • Let's look at the **meaning **of other words: • **Calm**: not excited, worried, or angry; quiet. (शांत, चुपचाप) • **Keen**: very interested in something; wanting to do something. (किसी बात में बहुत रुचि रखने वाला; कुछ करने का इच्‍छुक, लालायित, उत्‍सुक) • **Content**: happy or satisfied with what you have or do. (संतुष्‍ट) b5:T80f, The correct answer is '**appeared**'.
